description: Multisensor Condition Monitoring Dataset from a Sulzer Industrial Centrifuge at Arab Potash Company: A One-Year Time Series for Predictive Maintenance Research is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Doaa Ahmad Alqaraleh et al. This paper presents a publicly accessible industrial condition monitoring dataset collected from a Sulzer centrifuge at the Arab Potash Company (APC) in Jordan. Coverage: national (JO); published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The paper's page was read, but no repository address could be taken from its machine-readable metadata, so the record links to the article, whose Data Records section names where the data sit. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
